svg.title: PAI supply projection
svg.desc: Total supply starts at the 500M genesis allocation. Investors-and-founders tranches of 900M are minted as cumulative network fees pass each milestone, nine of ten within ten years in this scenario, reaching about 8.7B. Daily reward emission falls with halvings and network growth; daily fee burn rises with usage and overtakes emission around year 2.7. Generated from packages/pai.
